title: Minimum number of roof drains.
officialText:
Not less than two roof drains shall be installed in roof areas 10,000 square feet (929 m2) or
less and not less than four roof drains shall be installed in roofs over 10,000 square feet (929 m2) in area.
SECTION PC 1111
SUBSOIL DRAINS
